name: Jan na Kolno Prusimski

events.note: Married by 1673, when he gave a quittance for the last 12,000 of her 40,000 złoty dowry.
From Anna Bojanowska and her sons Jan and Andrzej, on the Monday after St Margaret 1698, under a penalty of 90,000 złp. Trąbczyn passed to the Prusimskis in one hand.

notes: No source states the date of his death; his sons divided his estates among themselves in 1700 and 1708.

Very probably the "Johann von Prusimski" whose inscription of 1673 charged the market town of Kolno with 1,500 złoty for the parish church of Kamionna (the Prussian mortgage certificate of Kolno, 1801-1803).
